title: Slow everywhere with one container pinned
query: All requests are slower with hardly any errors, and one container sits at 100 percent CPU.
root_cause: One service is CPU saturated, from a traffic spike or an expensive code path.

remediation.detail: Check for a traffic spike or recent release, roll back if release-related, otherwise profile the service.

evidence: docker stats shows one container at its CPU limit
Latency is high for all requests with a low error ratio
Request rate is higher than usual or a hot code path is active
